propositions: DET floor deterministically blocks epic close when any open/in_progress bug in the epic subtree carries a caused_by edge targeting the epic or its descendants, with a teaching message to fix/re-parent/dispute the link

Candidate filter identifies open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked via any relation/depth to the epic subtree (both directions), up to 32 candidates with overflow accounting

Haiku relevance screen assigns each candidate a forced-choice verdict (A: defect in deliverable, B: pre-existing/adjacent, C: unrelated) via single-turn LLM call with epic material in system prompt, forwarding A-verdicts as compact evidence (title+citation+id, max 8 rows)

Verifier adjudicates via show_ticket and blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects: passing dispositions are store-grounded (supersedes/duplicates link) or reasoned prose (pre-existence/deferral claim); bare 'out of scope' does not qualify; close_class never qualifies
Screen tally is recorded in completion sidecar including unevaluated-overflow count; screen failure degrades open (logged reason) and never blocks; DET floor remains the hard enforcement tier
Live calibration on regression set (30a2/5b09/30d3/e6a0/c8ed) proves real model->validator path end-to-end and verifier block/pass outcomes under store-grounded disposition rule
